{'0': 'Update, 5:36 p.m. ET: Apple has also released the fifth public betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a) and tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a).'}

{'1': 'Developers can now install the fifth betas of multiple upcoming software updates, including iPadOS 26.6. Here are the details.'}

{'2': 'iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and HomePod 26.6 beta 5 now available'}

{'3': 'As the beta cycle for Apple’s 26.6 software updates nears its end, the company is now seeding the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a), watchOS 26.6 (23U5062b), tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a), visionOS 26.6 (23O5765a), and HomePod 26.6 (23L5766a).'}

{'4': 'These updates are now rolling out alongside the fifth betas of iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, and like those, they mostly contain bug fixes, some of which Apple decided to push out early in response to growing AI-driven security threats.'}

{'5': 'This is likely the final round of betas before the release candidates. With the official versions of the 26.6 updates now imminent, much of the attention for Apple and the developer community is shifting to iOS 27 and its accompanying updates, which are expected to launch publicly this fall. Apple is also expected to release the first public betas soon.'}

{'6': 'In any case, developers can now install the fifth beta of iPadOS 26.6 and its counterparts, with public versions expected in the near future as well.'}
